items.title: "New cat alert!": the first new cat species in over 100 years
items.summary: National Geographic announced that a wildlife sanctuary's call about a "weird cat" led to the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years, found in Bolivia's Yungas forest. The post got 379K likes, and quotes like "NEW CAT DROPPED I REPEAT NEW CAT DROPPED" added more than 700K.
items.author: @NatGeo

post.name: National Geographic
post.text: New cat alert! A call from a wildlife sanctuary about a "weird cat" has led to the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years in Bolivia’s Yungas forest ecoregion. Learn more about this feline surprise: on.natgeo.com/JRuaGj
